segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: My husband is having trouble breathing and chest pain. He is awake but he cannot catch his breath.

segments.speaker: dispatcher
segments.text: Is he conscious and breathing right now?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yes, he is awake and breathing, but he says his chest hurts and he feels tight.

segments.speaker: dispatcher
segments.text: Does he have any history of heart problems or is he on any medications?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: He has a history of high blood pressure. He takes blood pressure medicine but not much else.

segments.speaker: dispatcher
segments.text: Is he having any nausea, sweating, or pain radiating to his arm or jaw?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: He is sweaty and says the pain is going down his left arm.

segments.speaker: dispatcher
segments.text: Is he allergic to anything or does he have any difficulty speaking?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: No allergies. He can speak, but he is very short of breath.

segments.speaker: dispatcher
segments.text: Okay, I am sending advanced life support and an ambulance to your location now.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Thank you. We are at 123 Oak Street, apartment 2B.
